1	"""Tests for the Tier 0–3 risk classifier.
2	
3	The classifier is the gate that decides which intents auto-execute, which
4	get notified, and which require HITL. Drift between this logic and mcpd's
5	catalogue is dangerous; the test_mcpd_catalogue suite covers that surface.
6	This suite focuses on the tier-decision rules themselves.
7	"""
8	
9	import os
10	
11	import pytest
12	
13	from controller._mcpd_tools import ALL_TOOLS
14	from controller.risk_classifier import ClassificationResult, Tier, classify
15	
16	
17	HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")
18	
19	
20	def _make_intent(action: str, target: str = "", risk_level: str = "low") -> dict:
21	    return {
22	        "action": action,
23	        "target": target,
24	        "params": {},
25	        "reason": "test",
26	        "risk_level": risk_level,
27	    }
28	
29	
30	# ── Tier 0: read-only ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
31	
32	@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", [
33	    "system.status", "system.uptime", "system.cpu",
34	    "system.memory", "system.disk",
35	    "process.list", "process.inspect",
36	    "fs.read", "fs.list", "fs.stat",
37	    "service.logs",
38	    "network.status", "network.dns.read",
39	    "package.query",
40	])
41	def test_tier0_read_only(action):
42	    r = classify(_make_intent(action))
43	    assert r.tier == Tier.READ_ONLY
44	    assert r.auto_execute
45	    assert not r.requires_hitl
46	    assert r.reversible
47	
48	
49	# ── Tier 1: fs.write inside $HOME ────────────────────────────────────────────
50	
51	def test_fs_write_in_home_is_tier1():
52	    r = classify(_make_intent("fs.write", f"{HOME}/notes.md"))
53	    assert r.tier == Tier.LOW
54	    assert r.auto_execute
55	    assert not r.requires_hitl
56	
57	
58	def test_fs_write_deep_in_home_is_tier1():
59	    r = classify(_make_intent("fs.write", f"{HOME}/projects/icebreaker/scratch"))
60	    assert r.tier == Tier.LOW
61	
62	
63	# ── Tier 2: system writes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
64	
65	@pytest.mark.parametrize("action,target", [
66	    ("package.install", "curl"),
67	    ("package.remove",  "vim"),
68	    ("package.upgrade", "openssl"),
69	    ("service.start",   "nginx.service"),
70	    ("service.stop",    "nginx.service"),
71	    ("service.restart", "nginx.service"),
72	])
73	def test_tier2_system_write(action, target):
74	    r = classify(_make_intent(action, target, risk_level="medium"))
75	    assert r.tier == Tier.MEDIUM
76	    assert r.auto_execute
77	    assert not r.requires_hitl
78	
79	
80	def test_package_actions_are_reversible():
81	    r = classify(_make_intent("package.install", "htop"))
82	    assert r.reversible is True
83	
84	
85	def test_service_actions_marked_irreversible():
86	    r = classify(_make_intent("service.restart", "nginx"))
87	    assert r.reversible is False
88	
89	
90	# ── Tier 3: destructive tools ────────────────────────────────────────────────
91	
92	def test_fs_delete_is_tier3():
93	    r = classify(_make_intent("fs.delete", "/var/log/app.log"))
94	    assert r.tier == Tier.HIGH
95	    assert r.requires_hitl
96	    assert not r.auto_execute
97	
98	
99	# ── Tier 3: fs.write outside $HOME ───────────────────────────────────────────
100	
101	def test_fs_write_outside_home_is_tier3():
102	    r = classify(_make_intent("fs.write", "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf"))
103	    assert r.tier == Tier.HIGH
104	    assert r.requires_hitl
105	
106	
107	# ── Tier 3: critical path targets ────────────────────────────────────────────
108	
109	@pytest.mark.parametrize("target", [
110	    "/boot/grub/grub.cfg",
111	    "/etc/sudoers",
112	    "/etc/shadow",
113	    "/etc/passwd",
114	    "/root/.ssh/authorized_keys",
115	    "/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id",
116	    "/dev/sda",
117	    "/dev/nvme0n1",
118	    "/sys/firmware/efi/efivars/anything",
119	])
120	def test_critical_paths_force_tier3(target):
121	    # Even with a Tier 0 read action, a critical-path target escalates to HIGH.
122	    r = classify(_make_intent("fs.read", target))
123	    assert r.tier == Tier.HIGH
124	    assert r.requires_hitl
125	    assert r.blocked_pattern is not None
126	
127	
128	# ── Tier 3: explicit risk_level=="critical" ──────────────────────────────────
129	
130	def test_explicit_critical_risk_level_forces_tier3():
131	    r = classify(_make_intent("fs.write", f"{HOME}/notes", risk_level="critical"))
132	    assert r.tier == Tier.HIGH
133	    assert r.requires_hitl
134	
135	
136	# ── Coverage: no tool falls into the "Unclassified" fallback ─────────────────
137	
138	def test_every_mcpd_tool_classifies_without_fallback():
139	    fallback_msg = "Unclassified action"
140	    unclassified = []
141	    for action in sorted(ALL_TOOLS):
142	        # For fs.write, supply an in-home target so it lands in Tier 1
143	        # (the alternate Tier 3 outside-home path is exercised above).
144	        target = f"{HOME}/scratch" if action == "fs.write" else ""
145	        r = classify(_make_intent(action, target))
146	        if fallback_msg in r.reason:
147	            unclassified.append(action)
148	    assert not unclassified, f"Tools landed in 'Unclassified' fallback: {unclassified}"
149	
150	
151	# ── Result invariants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
152	
153	def test_classification_result_invariants():
154	    # requires_hitl exactly when tier == HIGH; auto_execute exactly otherwise.
155	    for action in ALL_TOOLS:
156	        target = f"{HOME}/x" if action == "fs.write" else ""
157	        r = classify(_make_intent(action, target))
158	        assert isinstance(r, ClassificationResult)
159	        assert r.requires_hitl == (r.tier == Tier.HIGH)
160	        assert r.auto_execute != r.requires_hitl
161
